/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Bile
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Helminth is able to digest all manner of miscellaneous substances, but generates a large surplus of bile in order to do so. Fortunately, this bile can be repurposed.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionEn: Helminth is able to digest all manner of miscellaneous substances, but generates a large surplus of bile in order to do so. Fortunately, this bile can be repurposed.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionZh: Helminth 可以消化各种杂物，但会因此而产生过量的消化液。幸运的是，这些消化液可以再次被利用。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Biotics
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionEn: Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionZh: 各种植物类物质会在 Helminth 的消化道内被处理、液化，剩余的残留物则会被以无害惰性块状物的形式排出体外。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Calx
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionEn: On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionZh: 在享用矿物质时，Helminth 会把那些未被完全吸收的矿物质转化为光滑浓郁、并带有淡淡香草味的糊状物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Oxides
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionEn: Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionZh: 金属物质，被 Helminth 的消化液不断腐蚀，并以大颗粒粉尘的形式分泌了出来。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Pheromones
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: When Helminth consumes Infested matter it creates greasy intestine-like casings, bloats them with a dark, musky gas and ejects them. The reason for this is unknown and probably best left that way.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionEn: When Helminth consumes Infested matter it creates greasy intestine-like casings, bloats them with a dark, musky gas and ejects them. The reason for this is unknown and probably best left that way.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionZh: 当 Helminth 享用了感染物质后，它会产生油腻的肠道状外壳，并通过黑色的麝香气体使其膨胀，然后将其喷射出来。这种现象的产生原因不明，可能最好不要去管它。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Synthetics
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Helminth eagerly consumes artificial materials and exudes these rope-like strands of filament as a useful byproduct.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionEn: Helminth eagerly consumes artificial materials and exudes these rope-like strands of filament as a useful byproduct.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.descriptionZh: Helminth 热衷于享用人造材料，并会分泌出这些绳状的细丝，可被作为一种有用的副产品。

/Lotus/Types/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/Gam.name: Hunhow's Trinket
/Lotus/Types/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/Gam.description: The Blueprint for an unidentified item. Perhaps some ancient piece of Old War decor.
/Lotus/Types/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/Gam.descriptionEn: The Blueprint for an unidentified item. Perhaps some ancient piece of Old War decor.
/Lotus/Types/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/Gam.descriptionZh: 一件身份不明物品的蓝图。或许是远古之战时期的一件装饰品。
